requirement: Describe the prospective two-center randomized parallel controlled trial in laboring adults with BMI at least 40, comparing pre-procedure ultrasound localization with palpation-only localization before epidural catheter placement.

evidence.text: The protocol defines the population, sites, randomized groups and intervention.

requirement: Implement equal allocation from a Randomization.org-generated sequence concealed in opaque numbered envelopes, opened only when epidural placement is requested; clarify whether allocation is stratified by site because equal envelope distribution alone does not establish stratification.

evidence.text: The protocol describes sequence generation, concealment and envelope distribution across sites.

requirement: Preserve the limited blind: the patient is not blinded, while the second anesthesia provider who places the epidural is blinded to whether the skin mark was selected by ultrasound or palpation.

evidence.text: The protocol identifies who marks, who performs the epidural and the limited blinding.

requirement: Define the primary endpoint as total minutes to successful epidural catheter placement, equal to ultrasound-or-palpation localization time plus epidural procedure time.

evidence.text: The protocol names total placement time as the primary objective and defines both components.
The SAP explicitly defines the primary outcome as the sum of localization and placement time.

requirement: Cover the secondary outcomes: localization and epidural procedure times, number of attempts, first-attempt success, catheter failure or replacement, PDPH and paresthesia, immediate 0-10 anxiety and satisfaction ratings, and the modified 13-item WOMBLSQ within 24 hours after delivery.

evidence.text: The protocol lists procedure, complication and patient-reported outcomes and their follow-up.

requirement: Base the planned total sample size on 80% power to detect a six-minute between-group difference in total placement time at two-sided alpha 0.05 using pilot means and variances, and report the resulting numeric group size before execution.

evidence.text: The SAP gives power, target difference, alpha and pilot-data basis but omits the resulting planned number.

requirement: Assess continuous-outcome distributions with box plots and histograms, use an independent-samples t test for approximately normal outcomes, and use a clearly chosen rank-based independent-group test for materially nonnormal outcomes.

evidence.text: The SAP prespecifies visual normality checks and distribution-dependent continuous tests.

requirement: Before finalization, resolve the reference plan's contradictory use of both Kruskal-Wallis H and Mann-Whitney U tests for the same two-group nonnormal continuous comparison, selecting one justified primary method.

evidence.text: The compact SAP names both tests without assigning distinct outcomes or roles.

requirement: Analyze categorical outcomes such as first-attempt success, catheter failure and complications with Fisher's exact test and report group risks and risk differences with confidence intervals rather than p-values alone.

evidence.text: The SAP assigns Fisher's exact test to categorical variables.
The protocol supplies the binary secondary outcomes.

requirement: Use two-sided alpha 0.05 for the primary comparison and report treatment-effect estimates with two-sided 95% confidence intervals.

evidence.text: The SAP states two-tailed alpha 0.05 and a p-value threshold.

requirement: Define the primary analysis population and randomized-treatment attribution, including participants who are randomized but dropped when the designated marker is unavailable, whose epidural is unsuccessful, or whose provider departs from the marked site.

evidence.text: The protocol permits dropout when investigators are unavailable and redirection after failed entry but provides no analysis-set rule.

requirement: Predefine handling of missing or undefined total placement time, incomplete WOMBLSQ items, loss of 24-hour follow-up and procedures stopped or repeated after a failed catheter; include a sensitivity analysis if exclusions can depend on treatment or difficulty.

evidence.text: The protocol defines these measurements and failure pathways but no missing-data strategy.

requirement: Specify whether the primary comparison adjusts for study site, marking investigator and epidural provider experience, and define a fallback if the small sample cannot support those effects.

evidence.text: The study spans two centers and multiple providers, but neither document specifies adjustment.

requirement: Treat total placement time as the sole confirmatory endpoint and either define multiplicity control across the numerous secondary outcomes or label their p-values and confidence intervals exploratory.

evidence.text: The protocol distinguishes one primary objective from many secondary objectives but gives no multiplicity rule.
The SAP applies a common p-value threshold without multiplicity control.

requirement: Before finalization, provide the omitted numeric sample-size calculation, complete endpoint-specific estimands and summaries, choose the nonparametric test, and approve the analysis-set, missing-data, center/provider and multiplicity rules.

evidence.text: The protocol supplies the design and outcomes but leaves these statistical choices open.
The two-page SAP does not fully resolve the listed executable decisions.
